label: Hexagon French Cuff — 4 Buttonholes
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Real photo of a white folded double (French) cuff lying on dark polished wood, fastened with a single gold block-letter 'M' cufflink; bottom of frame carries added serif caption text 'ANGLED FRENCH CUFF'. The cuff's forward corner near the cufflink reads as a diagonal/mitered cut rather than a clean 90-degree square, which is consistent with the hexagon/angled cuff, but the miter is soft and partly lost in the fold. Only one cufflink face is visible and no buttonholes are countable, so the '4 buttonholes' part of the label cannot be confirmed at all.
